description: Spacious and generous. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa and seating area in the upper living zone facing the central coffee table and TV; dining table with six chairs set to the right side near the windows. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible, 22 m² — large enough for bunk beds. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 1 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. 1 separate WC. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child; two adults sharing independently — each with private bathroom access; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: large families needing more than two bedrooms; households requiring a dedicated home office with natural light separate from bedrooms; wheelchair users who need step-free direct access given the turning corridor layout.
